messages:
ashley: quick thread  thinking about a hybrid speculative approach for RAG workflows on the new 13B-quant model. goal: keep retrieval latency low while not amplifying hallucinations. jotting notes.

tom: high level?

ashley: two-stage speculative: (1) retrieval-only early answer using dense-sim top1 + cheap decoder head for a candidate answer; (2) if uncertainty high, run full reranker + full decode with context. idea is to avoid fetching many docs + full decode for easy Qs.

rachel: how do you define "uncertainty" in RAG? calibration's messy with quantized weights.

ashley: predictor uses token-level entropy + retrieval-score delta. compute small LM-score over retrieved snippet (128 tokens) with `tiny-head-256`. threshold tuned per-quant run.

ci-bot: ci/rag-hybrid-proto triggered  job=5109 logs: https://ci/internal/5109

tom: what about retrieved-doc freshness / mismatch? if early answer picks wrong doc, we might lock on bad context.

ashley: plan: early-answer is flagged with a provenance tag; for any entity-like answers run a cheap NER + factual-check pass against top3 docs. if mismatch -> fallback.

rachel: metrics to watch?

ashley: overall: exact-match (QA), LlamaScore drift, hallucination-rate (auto-detector), RR@1 for retriever, token/sec, latency p50/p95. also manual Triage for 100 failures.

ci-bot: artifact uploaded -> s3://internal/rag-hybrid/5109/summary.json

ashley: mini-config snippet:
```
hybrid_rag:
  predictor:
    model: tiny-head-256
    entropy_thresh: 4.0
    retriever_delta_thresh: 0.12
  checks:
    ner_prov: true
    fallback_policy: full-rerank-decode
  max_early_tokens: 128
```

tom: how to handle quant variance? same re-cal strategy as other threads?

ashley: yes. run 3 quant kernels (int8/q4/q8) and isotonic recal on a 3k prompt holdout per kernel. keep mapping artifacts with build tags. automate after any `quant-*` build.

rachel: we should also test with adversarial retriever prompts (noisy queries). early-answer could be worse there.

ashley: adding adversarial cohort (1k queries) to matrix. also add ablation: with/without NER prov check.

ci-bot: ci/rag-hybrid-proto job 5109 completed  results: quick-sanity passed, perf-run queued -> https://ci/internal/5109/results

ashley: preliminary numbers (2k samples): recall@1 unchanged, avg token/sec +1.6x, overall EM -0.9% (worse on entity factuals). with NER provenance enabled EM drop reduced to -0.3%.

tom: promising. next: full 10k sweep + human triage on entity failures. who owns what?

ashley: i'll run 10k + re-cal jobs. tom do infra for 8x-A100 throughput. rachel lead human triage.

rachel: will spin up label UI and start on 50 sample spotcheck.

ashley: tagging infra for permission to use retriever cache TTL=1h for the sweep. also drafting an ops runbook listing fallbacks. will post shortly.

ci-bot: job 5109 perf-run started  node=8-a100-1

tom: noted. will watch for GPU memory pressure with q4 kernels.

ashley: thanks all. will post final plots and a short README in INF-579.
